name: Piezo Disc Sensor
specs: 27mm ceramic disc, 2-wire (red=signal, black=GND), ~1–100Hz strike bandwidth. Used as analog input, not driven as output.

name: Series Resistor (100k)
specs: 100kΩ, 1/4W, ±5%. Limits current into analog input pin and tames high-voltage piezo spikes.

name: Bleed Resistor (1MΩ)
specs: 1MΩ, 1/4W, ±5%. Provides DC path to GND so the signal node does not float between piezo strikes.

name: Full-size Breadboard
specs: 830 holes, 63 rows x 10 cols + power rails.

name: Arduino Uno R3 (Bela stand-in for simulator)
specs: ATmega328P, 10-bit ADC (0–5V on A0). On the real build, replace with Bela board (12-bit ADC, 0–4.096V).
